symbols.name: array of complex values
symbols.meaning: A finite array of complex values, the argument of the norm.
symbols.quote: Let $X$ be a finite array of complex values.

symbols.name: array entry
symbols.meaning: A single entry of the array X, which is a complex number.
symbols.quote: Let $w$ range over the entries of $X$, each a complex number.

symbols.name: array norm
symbols.meaning: The largest modulus of the entries of the array X, a nonnegative real number.
symbols.quote: The norm of $X$, written $\|X\|$, is the largest modulus $|w|$ over all entries $w$ of $X$.
